updates.title: Mimi plays the poison for the cameras
updates.body: Something in Quadrant C poisons her in the first ten minutes and she holds the room for a full minute anyway. The System rates the performance highly and the poison not at all.

updates.title: Mimi trades a cracked visor for a clear one
updates.body: The Butcher Row costs her a visor and pays her back with a better one. She reads a room that is not there, takes the Static Diviner title, and stops narrating her own thoughts, which the audience objects to.

updates.title: Mimi names the cold before it speaks
updates.body: She calls the thing on the Brine Stairs by name while it is still deciding whether to have one. The frost leaves a scar along her jaw that the Cartographer Sigil does nothing about.
